'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–2023)|M23 offensive]]
***At least four [[civilian]]s and three [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|soldiers]] are killed, with 11 injured, in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[IDP camp]] in [[Nyiragongo Territory|Nyiragongo]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|DRC]], amid ongoing conflict between the army and [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels. [https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/world/shooting-in-eastern-dr-congo-kills-at-least-s-NV_175173 (AFP via ''New Vision'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***The Jebel Aulia Bridge, part of the [[Jebel Aulia Dam]] complex on the [[White Nile]] river, is destroyed amid heavy fighting in [[Jabal Awliya]], although the dam itself remains intact. It is the second bridge in [[Khartoum]] to be destroyed in the past week. [https://sudantribune.com/article279489/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Miss Universe 2023]]
**[[Miss Nicaragua]] [[Sheynnis Palacios]] is crowned [[Miss Universe]] by her [[Miss Universe 2022|predecessor]], [[R'Bonney Gabriel]], marking the [[Nicaragua|country]]'s first win in the pageant's history. [https://edition.cnn.com/style/miss-universe-2023-nicaragua-sheynnis-palacios/index.html (CNN)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Uttarakhand tunnel collapse]]
**Efforts to rescue 40 workers trapped in a collapsed tunnel in [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]], are suspended due to concerns of further [[cave-in]]s. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1790585/tunnel-rescue-efforts-paused-in-india-over-fears-of-cave-in (AFP via ''Dawn'')]
*[[November 2023 Brazil heat wave]]
**[[Death of Ana Clara Benevides]]
***A woman dies at the first of American singer [[Taylor Swift]]'s [[The Eras Tour|concert]]s at the [[Estádio Olímpico Nilton Santos]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], [[Brazil]], during a day when temperatures reached {{conv|39.1|C|F}}. Swift postpones her second concert in the city due to the heat. [https://www.theguardian.com/music/2023/nov/18/taylor-swift-fan-dies-before-brazil-concert-amid-sweltering-conditions (''The Guardian'')] [https://mb.com.ph/2023/11/18/swift-postpones-rio-show-due-to-extreme-heat-after-fan-death (AFP via ''Manila Bulletin'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Politics of France|France]]'s [[Horizons (political party)|Horizons]] [[List of political parties in France|party]] suspends [[Loire-Atlantique]] [[Senate (France)|Senator]] [[Joël Guerriau]] following his arrest and formal [[criminal charge|charge]] for allegedly administering a [[date rape drug]] to [[National Assembly (France)|MP]] [[Sandrine Josso]], with [[The Independents – Republic and Territories group|the Independents]] [[Parliamentary group|caucus]] in the Senate also suspending him and initiating [[Impeachment|expulsion]] procedures. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/french-party-suspends-senator-amid-shock-over-date-rape-case (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election]]
**Four major [[Politics of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] [[List of political parties in the Democratic Republic of the Congo|parties]] form a [[coalition]] to contest [[President of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|President]] [[Félix Tshisekedi]] in the upcoming election. [[Martin Fayulu]]'s party remains absent from the agreement. [https://www.thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/news/africa/four-dr-congo-opposition-parties-sign-coalition-pact-4437962 (AFP via ''The Citizen'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[SpaceX Starship Second Integrated Flight Test]]
**American [[aerospace manufacturer]] [[SpaceX]] launches the second [[test flight]] of the [[SpaceX Starship|Starship]] rocket, at [[SpaceX Starbase|Starbase]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]], reaching an altitude of {{conv|148|km|mi}}. The [[SpaceX Super Heavy|Super Heavy]] booster [[explode]]s shortly after separation, with the second stage terminating itself eight minutes into the flight. [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/11/18/spacex-starship-second-rocket-launch.html (CNBC)] [https://edition.cnn.com/world/live-news/spacex-starship-launch-scn/index.html (CNN)]
